newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE - JUNE 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE - JUNE 12.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Fighting in Brazzaville, Congo, has killed thousands of civilians.
-- OFCE head economist Jean-Paul Fitoussi says in an interview French questioning of the European "stability pact" does not jeopardise European monetary union.
-- Hopes of an agreement on the European stability pact reassures financial markets, franc wins back some ground lost against the mark.
-- Cie de Suez shareholders approved merger project with Lyonnaise des Eaux.
